UM: the encounter's createNpcs() returns its result; it builds the boss (id "zuk") into this.boss and the shield (id "zuk_shield") into this.glyph; shared name: InfernoEncounter.js lines 210 and 744 call it on this.zuk
jM: called with setup.zukShieldStart; it sets this.initialGlyphTargetEndpoint and the shield's state.targetEndpoint; shared name: InfernoEncounter.js line 218 calls it on this.zuk
OM: inferred: a getter for the ids of this.glyph and this.boss; configureRunStart() despawns them when the run leaves the fight; shared name: InfernoEncounter.js line 222 reads it on this.zuk
VM: the engine's buildNpcDefinitionContext() makes the same argument for the definitions' calls; this one adds random; shared name: InfernoEncounter.js line 641 calls it on this.zuk, and the encounter class has its own member of the same name; shared name: InfernoEncounter.js line 640 calls it on this.zuk, its other accesses there are the encounter's own
KM: the encounter's getSnapshot() stores its result under the key zuk of state ({ setTimer, timerPaused, enraged, jadSpawned, shieldX, shieldMovingEast, shieldNextX }); shared name: InfernoEncounter.js line 406 calls it on this.zuk
qM: inferred: this.boss is alive and is the NPC the world holds under its id; it gates syncBossHp() and the encounter's enterBossHpPhase(); shared name: InfernoEncounter.js line 439 calls it on this.zuk
GM: its result is assigned to this.initialGlyphTargetEndpoint; 0 for "left", 1 for "right", otherwise a bit of the hashed seed
XM: error string "Cannot sync Zuk cast clock without a shield"; it sets the boss state's lastCastTick to null and firstCastTick from the shield's spawnTick
YM: its result is passed as id of the spawned actors (`zuk_${kind}_${n}`); it counts this.nextActorId; the encounter class has its own member of the same name
QM: the command cases "demonstrate-jad", "demonstrate-set" and "demonstrate-heal" pass its result to the visual builders; it spawns an actor without an NPC definition
$M: the command case "spawn-set" calls it; a mager and a ranger
JM: the command cases "spawn-mager" and "spawn-ranger" call it
ZM: the command case "clear-spawns" calls it and returns the game event "inferno_clear_minions"; it despawns the NPCs with role "minion", optionally only the given npcTypeIds

iT: inferred: the keys of the entries of this.pillars whose intact is true, as a Set; passed to the pillar refinement of the arena config
rT: inferred: sets the arena config in force again from this.arenaBase and the intact pillars; called when the run start is configured and when a pillar collapses
aT: inferred: runSeed, mixed with attemptSeed when there is one; it seeds the wave's "npc" decision stream and the Zuk fight's random, while the spawn layout and the nibbler pillar use runSeed alone
YM: its result is passed as id of a spawned wave monster (`inferno_${kind}_${n}`); it counts this.nextActorId; the Zuk fight class has its own member of the same name
VM: the engine's buildNpcDefinitionContext() makes the same argument for the definitions' calls; this one adds random and decisions, or forwards to the Zuk fight's member of the same name
sT: its result is assigned to this.setup ({ startWave, zukShieldStart, destroyedPillars, spawnLayout, startTile, pinnedWave })
mT: getSnapshot() stores its result under the key startPlayerTile; the setup's startTile as "x,y", or "" when the start wave has a fixed start
nT: getDefaultPlayerStart() returns its result for the setup read from the mechanics
hT: planRestartStart() returns its result and planPracticeRestart() stores it under the key startPosition
eT: error string "A wave-69 NPC acted before wave 69 began"; returns this.zuk
lT: error string "Wave 69's intro needs the engine's player teleport"; by the tick's offset from this.zukControlTick it says the messages, teleports the player, spawns the Zuk fight's NPCs and starts wave 69
oT: it sets this.pillarsMaterialized and spawns the NPCs "inferno_pillar_<key>" of the intact pillars
tT: registered with the "inferno-rocky-support" definition as collapse; emits "inferno_pillar_collapse"; error string "A pillar collapse needs the engine hit queue"
gT: it calls spawnNpc for a wave monster and records it in this.combatants ({ kind, origin })
cT: emits the message "Wave: N" (`Wave: ${this.wave}`), spawns the wave's layout and sets phase "active"
dT: emits the message "Wave completed!" once this.combatants is empty, then raises this.wave and sets phase "countdown"
